description: This file is a server entry point for a Node.js application that sets up server listening, manages PID files for singleton enforcement, connects to MongoDB via Mongoose, and handles process signals for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: ensurePidFileGuard
methods.description: Checks for existing PID file and active process to prevent multiple instances.

methods.name: writePidFile
methods.description: Writes current process PID to the PID file.

methods.name: removePidFile
methods.description: Removes the PID file if it exists.

methods.name: startServerStrict
methods.description: Starts the server, sets up signal handlers, and manages graceful shutdown.
